limitations_and_boundaries: The paper only presents results for spatial resolution 64x64 for Navier-Stokes because all compared benchmarks are designed for this resolution; increasing it degrades their performance while FNO achieves the same errors.
For Navier-Stokes with insufficient data (ν=1e-4, N=1000 and ν=1e-5, N=1000), all methods have >15% error, indicating data efficiency limitations.

The 2D+RNN structure (FNO-2D) can propagate the solution to any arbitrary time T in increments of a fixed interval length Δt, while the Conv3D structure (FNO-3D) is fixed to the interval [0, T] but can transfer the solution to an arbitrary time-discretization.
